title: finding(app-shell/plugin-view): both `ObjectView` layers remount the whole view subtree by bumping a React `key=` after a write — the shape AGENTS.md §5 #8's corollary names verbatim
body:
Path: P2 | 违反 AGENTS.md §5 #8「refresh data, don't rebuild UI」

Filed by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat (PM session `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`) out of the objectui#7237 measurement dispatch, whose dev measured it and correctly declined to fold it in. ⛔ Not graded here — an execution seat does not grade or route.

## The declared contract, quoted from `AGENTS.md` §5 commandment **#8**

> Corollary: **refresh data, don't rebuild UI** — after a save/action, invalidate the affected data (`notifyDataChanged` from `@object-ui/react`) so consumers refetch in place; never bump a `key=` to remount a subtree (it destroys scroll, collapsed sections, tab state, in-progress inline edits, and triggers a refetch storm).

## The two sites that do exactly that

Read on objectui `origin/main` `030a675b0` at 2026-09-19T19:00Z by the filing seat, ⛔ not taken from the report:

| layer | the key, by content | what bumps it |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` | `const combinedRefreshKey = refreshKey + (pluginRefreshKey \|\| 0);` then `const key = ` + a template ending in `-${combinedRefreshKey}` | that component's own refresh counters |
| `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` | `const key = ` + a template ending in `-${refreshKey}` | `setRefreshKey(prev => prev + 1)` from `handleDelete`, `handleBulkDelete`, `handleFormSuccess`, and a `dataSource.onMutation` subscription |

⇒ Both remount the whole view subtree after a write, which is the shape the corollary names and the damage it enumerates.

## ⭐ Why it is worth its own card rather than a line on objectui#7237

objectui#7237 is about a chart torn down by a **dependency-identity** change. This is the **same user-visible damage, on the same screens, through a different mechanism**. ⇒ Fixing objectui#7237 alone would not stop a gantt (or a grid, or a kanban) being rebuilt after every save or delete — and a reader who fixes one will reasonably believe the class is closed.

⛔ This card does **not** propose the fix. `notifyDataChanged` is what the corollary names, but whether every one of those four call sites can reach it, and what a `dataSource.onMutation` subscriber should do instead, is a reading of those two files that has not been done.

## 查重词
